confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Madrid price levels, not live listings. Café and restaurant anchors are firmer than July hotel and hostel rates, which swing with demand and events. Euro prices were converted at an approximate general-knowledge rate, not a live quote. The FX value came from search-result content rather than an opened RBA page, and one RBA page's date metadata conflicts with its contents, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before formal use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Estimates reflect Madrid's own general price levels, loosely sanity-checked against other Southern European capitals with similar tourism demand. Cocktail and wine were also checked against the beer anchor for relative consistency.
